beats.story: I can understand feeling like you had no choice." She nods again shakily, but I can tell she's holding herself together. "And I'm so sorry about reading your emails and messing with your job. I truly am." Moisture shines in the corners of her eyes. She dares a tiny smile as she quietly mouths, "Thank you," then dabs her eyes with a tissue from her purse. "Congrats on the promotion, by the way. Cliff told me." My smile is genuine. Her eyes lock on to mine, a little steadier. "I appreciate it." "Also, I should thank you too." "For what?" "For helping me lose that job." She blinks at me, then a high-pitched cackle escapes her.
beats.story_cn: “我能理解那种别无选择的感受。”她再次颤抖着点头，但我看得出她在强撑。“还有真的很抱歉擅自看你的邮件、搅黄你的工作。我是真心的。”她眼角泛起水光，尝试扬起一个细小的微笑时轻轻说了句“谢谢”，随后从包里抽出纸巾轻拭眼角。“顺便恭喜你升职，克里夫告诉我的。”我的笑容是真诚的。她的目光落回我眼中，稍显稳定：“我很感激。”“另外，我也该谢谢你。”“谢什么？”“谢谢你让我丢了那份工作。”她怔了怔，随即发出一串清脆的笑声。

beats.story: It's the same cackle that set me on edge for so many years, but now it's kind of nice to hear. "Truly." I look around the community center, at all these familiar faces. "I never would've left otherwise. And for me that would've been tragic." She smiles again shyly. "I'm happy you're doing well." "Caitlin!" We both turn to spot Garret waving a hand at her from across the "dance floor" that I'm worried people will start using. "Come try this and tell me if it tastes like the wings from the Unicorn!" I laugh. "See you around." She smiles once more and walks away. Alone with nobody to talk to at a party once again, I fall back against the bleachers.
beats.story_cn: 就是那笑声，曾让我紧张许多年，但现在听来却有点亲切了。“真的。”我环视社区中心，望着这些熟悉的面孔，“若非如此，我绝不会离开。那对我将是莫大的遗憾。”她又羞涩地笑了笑。“看到你过得好，我很高兴。”“凯特琳！”我们同时转身，看见加勒特在“跳舞区”——我真担心人们会开始用起这地方——那头朝她挥手。“来尝尝这个，告诉我它是不是像独角兽酒吧的鸡翅！”我笑了。“回见。”她又笑了笑，转身离去。派对上再次无人可聊，我靠回看台。

I know too much about them in the absurd way that basically living with people in an office for forty hours a week always is. It's incredible. And awful. Yet deep affection for every single one of them swells in my chest. I was so lucky to have crossed paths with them for a time. Except it's more than that. I take a breath and the smile comes easily.
beats.story_cn: “我确实如此。”我凝望着整场派对，这些形形色色的职场怪人。我以那种每周与人共处四十小时、近乎同居般的荒诞方式，对他们了解太多。这不可思议，又糟糕透顶。然而胸腔里却为他们每个人涌动着深切的情谊。能有一段时光与他们相遇，我是如此幸运。不止如此。我深吸一口气，笑意自然浮现。

Somebody in this crowd might be saying something bad about me behind my back. I'll do something, somewhere, out of pettiness soon. Acknowledgments Getting here took a lot of help, but I'm glad it did, because the real book was the people I met along the way.

beats.story: To Julia McDowell, for your incredible insights, brainstorms, enthusiasm, and guidance, and to Iris Tupholme, Jennifer Lambert, Michael Guy-Haddock, Cory Beatty, and everyone else at Harper Canada for championing my book at home. To Jesse Q. Sutanto and Grace Shim. You went above and beyond as mentors and became true friends. It's a wonder how kind and giving people can be. Thank you for inspiring me, helping me, and seeing the potential. Thanks also for the DM screams, for sharing so much of yourselves, and for being all around delightful. To my critique partners, Ashlyn Cramer and Kira Quan, for your valuable perspective.
beats.story_cn: 感谢朱莉娅·麦克道尔，你的真知灼见、头脑风暴、热忱与指引至关重要。感谢艾瑞斯·塔普霍姆、詹妮弗·兰伯特、迈克尔·盖-哈多克、科里·比蒂及哈珀柯林斯加拿大公司全体同仁，在本国为我这本著作据理力争。感谢杰西·Q·苏坦托与格蕾丝·shim。你们超越导师的范畴，成为了真正的朋友。人心之善与慷慨竟如此动人，实属奇迹。感谢你们的启发、帮助与赏识。也感谢那些深夜的私信欢呼，感谢你们分享自我，感谢你们始终如一的美好。感谢我的写作伙伴艾什琳·克拉默与基拉·全，你们提供了宝贵视角。

beats.story: It's been so satisfying seeing our projects evolve. I love our team! To anyone who shared any group chat or server with me where we met through writing but truly came together to share disturbing content and gossip -- that's been one of my favorite parts since pursuing this. To my fellow talented mentees and everyone at Pitchwars and AMM, thank you for all you did and the programs you provided that helped so many. I will always be grateful to Dana Mele and Aimee Salter, for seeing potential in my earlier writing. To my fellow 2024 debuts, thanks for being such a genuinely supportive group as we navigate publishing. Also, for your incredible books. To the writing community at large, thanks for sharing so much info and encouragement.
beats.story_cn: 看着我们的项目一点点成形，真是莫大的满足。我爱我们的团队！致任何曾在群聊或服务器里与我相遇的同道——我们因写作结缘，却真正凝聚于分享骇人见闻和八卦——自从走上这条路，这便是我最爱的部分之一。致我才华横溢的导师伙伴们，以及Pitchwars和AMM的所有同仁，感谢你们所做的一切，感谢你们提供惠泽众人的项目。我将永远感激Dana Mele与Aimee Salter，在我早期写作中看到了潜力。致2024年同期出道的伙伴们，感谢你们在出版征途上成为如此真诚互助的团体。也感谢你们那些精彩的书。致整个写作社群，感谢你们分享的海量信息与鼓励。

beats.story: Special thanks to Leah Jordain for about a trillion things, but especially for encouraging me to pursue this project at just the right time. Over the years of querying and through my journey to debuting, I've had the pleasure of crossing paths with wonderful people in the industry. To anyone I've met with, anyone who offered feedback, or anyone who guided me: I remember every kindness and kind word. Sincerely, thank you for your time and consideration. To the miscellaneous weirdos (affectionate) who I worked with at an office some time ago, thank you. Special thanks to Cassandra Madsen and William Tran. Thanks to my amazing supportive extended family and friends. There are too many to name as I'm very lucky despite myself.
beats.story_cn: 特别感谢莉亚·乔丹，为那约一万亿件事，但尤其感谢她在恰当时机鼓励我启动这个项目。在多年投稿与出道之旅中，我有幸与业内诸多优秀的人相逢。致我曾会面的任何人，提供过反馈的任何人，指引过我的任何人：我铭记每一份善意与每一句良言。衷心感谢你们付出的时间与考量。致那些曾在某间办公室共事过的、形形色色的怪咖们（爱称），谢谢你们。特别感谢卡桑德拉·马德森和威廉·特兰。感谢我那了不起、支持我的大家庭和朋友们。贵人太多，难以尽述，尽管我时常犯傻，却总是无比幸运。

beats.story: If we've ever shared a meal or adventure, I mean you. Special thanks to Emery Eden for the support (and the Warhammer help). To the people of Iran, to those who lost their lives and those who continue to fight for freedom: you are the definition of bravery. I hope there comes a time when you don't need to be brave, and you are able to follow the dreams that everyone deserves to have. To Christina, thank you for being the best sister. Your support has been a constant in life, so much so that I'm used to it. Thank you for never making me have to be not used to it. Mom and Dad, thank you for everything.
beats.story_cn: 如果我们曾共享一顿饭或一次冒险，我说的就是你。特别感谢艾默里·伊登的支持（以及战锤的帮助）。致伊朗的人民，致那些逝去的生命和仍在为自由而战的人们：你们是勇气的化身。我盼望有朝一日，你们不必再鼓起勇气，也能去追寻每个人都应拥有的梦想。致克里斯蒂娜，感谢你成为最好的姐姐。你的支持是我生命里恒久不变的存在，以至于我早已习惯。谢谢你，让我从未不得不去习惯“不习惯”这件事。爸爸妈妈，感谢你们给予的一切。

beats.story: You gave me more and have done more than I could ever sufficiently thank you for, and you still do. Also, for basically being a personal catering service at times and being the best grandparents. Thanks for handselling to extended family and friends, and for all the material both of your actions provide in general. To Ken, thank you for all the ways you've supported me in this pursuit and in life. It takes a special person to support a writer. For your undying belief and for treating it as an inevitability. For saying it's probably funny before hearing it. I save my worst jokes for you.
beats.story_cn: 你们给我的，为我做的，远超过我能言谢的范畴，而且至今仍在继续。感谢你们时不时充当私人厨师团队，成为世界上最棒的祖父母。感谢你们向亲友们热情推荐这本书，感谢你们用行动提供的所有写作素材。肯，谢谢你以各种方式支持我追求写作与生活。支持一个作家需要非凡的胸襟。谢谢你始终坚信这终将成真，甚至在听故事前就断言“这一定很有趣”。我故意把最烂的笑话留给你讲。

About the Author NATALIE SUE is a Canadian writer of Iranian and British descent. She spent her formative years moving around western Canada with a brief stint in Scotland, where she discovered her passion for storytelling as a means of connection and reading as a means of comfort. When she's not writing, she enjoys bingeing great and terrible TV, attempting pottery, and procuring houseplants. She lives in Calgary with her husband, daughter, and dog.
